publication.title: ViziQuer: Notation and tool for data analysis SPARQL queries

source_reading.scope: Complete main report: introduction, basic patterns, aggregation, expressions/vendor extensions and conclusions; references inspected for companion provenance.

adjudication.basis: ViziQuer implements UML-style construction of instance-data queries with aggregation, optional/negation patterns, grouping and expressions translated to SPARQL1.1. Concrete query patterns extend the interaction method; no new human or runtime evaluation is reported.

codes.notes: Rich expressions are within diagram attributes; no separate formal SPARQL editor established. Query-pattern examples in the report do not by themselves establish interactive guidance. Result visualization and web reimplementation are future work; the current diagram UI is implemented.

limitations: Initial Latvian medical registry experience is cited without a new sample or measured outcomes. No controlled evaluation here.

descriptions.interaction: Define UML-style class/link patterns, optional/negated constraints, aggregates, grouping scopes, explicit subqueries and attribute/property-path expressions; translate to SPARQL1.1.
descriptions.guidance: Explicit class-instance patterns and reusable query patterns lower the entry requirements.
descriptions.visualisation: ["UML-style class boxes and association links", "Embedded textual attribute/condition expressions"]
descriptions.backend: RDF instance data; schema loaded from OWL or an endpoint
